title: Google\Cloud\Spanner\V1\ExecuteBatchDmlResponse
name: ExecuteBatchDmlResponse
description: The response for [ExecuteBatchDml][google.spanner.v1.Spanner.ExecuteBatchDml]. Contains a list of [ResultSet][google.spanner.v1.ResultSet] messages, one for each DML statement that has successfully executed, in the same order as the statements in the request. If a statement fails, the status in the response body identifies the cause of the failure.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.result_sets
params.description: One [ResultSet][google.spanner.v1.ResultSet] for each statement in the request that ran successfully, in the same order as the statements in the request. Each [ResultSet][google.spanner.v1.ResultSet] does not contain any rows. The [ResultSetStats][google.spanner.v1.ResultSetStats] in each [ResultSet][google.spanner.v1.ResultSet] contain the number of rows modified by the statement. Only the first [ResultSet][google.spanner.v1.ResultSet] in the response contains valid [ResultSetMetadata][google.spanner.v1.ResultSetMetadata].

params.name: data.status
params.description: If all DML statements are executed successfully, the status is OK. Otherwise, the error status of the first failed statement.
